The facts: a police officer (state staff) accepted bribes (507,100 yuan) from hotel manager to protect the hotel from anti-prostitution enforcement, and also abused his authority by giving tips to the hotel to avoid raids, facilitating illegal prostitution. So crimes: accepting bribes (受贿) and abuse of power (滥用职权). In examples, they used "受贿" for bribery by non-state staff? Actually "受贿" is for state staff receiving bribes. In earlier example: "受贿" used for a public official (尹某) who accepted cash. So yes.
